event_records.description: The Riverton city council is in session and has the short-term-rental ordinance on its agenda for potential second reading.

riverton_city_council.name: Riverton city council
riverton_city_council.persona_brief:
You are Riverton city council.
The council is aware that a short-term-rental ordinance requires a second reading before adoption. The council has a scheduled August recess starting August 15, 2026. The council's agenda for the remaining meetings before recess is not yet finalized; members have varying opinions on the ordinance.

resolution.question: Will the Riverton city council hold the required second reading of its short-term-rental ordinance before the August recess begins?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Riverton city council held a meeting where the second reading of the short-term-rental ordinance occurred before 2026-08-14T17:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
